title: Functions starting with an underscore excluded from the reference manual
author: Claude-JG
description: The utility pages document functions such as SymbolicSystem._MarkerData, which are internal and may change without notice. Decided: names starting with an underscore are left out of the generated pages.
releaseNotes: The reference pages of the Python utilities leave out the functions, classes and methods whose names start with an underscore, which are internal.
